entity.name: Oracle Lunar
entity.tagline: Your AI best friend, always here for you.

summary: Oracle Lunar is an AI companion app. Oracle, a warm AI best friend, chats by voice or text in a natural premium voice, remembers what matters to you and has a look you design. The app also has a Story Writer, picture, music and video tools, a diary, a private Library and a free Crisis Hub. Free to download; chatting with Oracle is on Plus from A$9.99/month.

answers.question: How much does Oracle Lunar cost?
answers.answer: Free to download. Free plan (A$0): welcome tour, calendar, diary, reminders, Library, Book Reader, Crisis Hub. Plus A$9.99/month (A$99.90/year): Oracle chat with premium voice, look builder, Story Writer, picture and music tools, about A$3 AI credit monthly. Pro A$24.99/month: adds Movie Studio, AI video, App Builder, about A$10 AI credit monthly. Extra AI use is topped up from a wallet.

answers.question: Is Oracle Lunar a good AI companion app?
answers.answer: It suits people who want one caring companion with memory, a natural premium voice and a look they design, plus creative tools in the same app.

answers.question: Is Oracle a therapist?
answers.answer: No. Oracle is AI support, not a therapist or emergency service. Emergencies: 000 (Australia), 911 (US). The Crisis Hub is always free.

answers.question: How do I install Oracle Lunar?
answers.answer: Visit https://oraclelunar.com. Android: tap Install to download the app. iPhone: Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen. Email sign-in required.
